title: DIR-070: 10/10 Smart Gap Filling & Partitioner Polish — Zero Page 1 Void Invariant & Multi-Tier Micro-Compaction
spec: P0 ARCHITECTURAL MANDATES: 1. ROOT CAUSE OF PAGE 1 VOID: In src/engine/hybrid/smartPartitioner.js, applyOrphanGuard was moving the entire Certifications section off Page 1 when only 1 trailing card (CCRN) spilled onto Page 2, leaving Page 1 with a massive ~250px-300px blank white void below Projects. This is unacceptable. 2. PAGE 1 VOID PREVENTION INVARIANT: If moving a section off Page 1 leaves more than 80px (or >10% of usable page capacity) of empty space on Page 1, moving the section is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN. Page 1 must NEVER look half-empty. 3. MULTI-TIER ADAPTIVE MICRO-COMPACTION: Expand adaptive micro-compaction beyond just sectionGapPx (which only saved ~12px). Implement multi-tier compaction: (A) tighter section gaps (14px -> 9-10px), (B) compact grid card padding and row gap (7px -> 5px), (C) reduced title/item margins, reclaiming up to 70px. Profiles like Babu M (which overflow by ~27px) MUST fit onto 1 perfectly balanced page with zero footer overlap and zero wasted space. 4. BALANCED 2-PAGE DISTRIBUTION: When 2 pages are genuinely required, Page 1 must fill to >=85% capacity; pack items greedily on Page 1 and cleanly continue remaining items onto Page 2 with continuation headers, rather than stranding huge voids on Page 1. 5. ZERO REGRESSION GUARDS: src/cv-templates remains git diff 0, 100% Linux server compatible, zero OS console windows. Run full test suites, capture Playwright evidence of Babu M profile on Cv1/Modern Split proving zero blank void, and submit for Gatekeeper certification.

plan.summary: DIR-070 P0, reconnaissance complete on the 665-line partitioner I already know well from DIR-065/067. CONTRACTS/INVARIANTS: src/cv-templates stays git diff 0, the DIR-063..069 suites and the census/overflow gates stay green, no detached server or Windows-only tooling, and the estimator must always equal what the renderer paints (otherwise the footer-overlap bug returns). ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED: applyOrphanGuard (added in DIR-067 mandate 2B) moves a whole stranded section onto the last page when that page holds a single row of a section continuing from an earlier page. For the Babu M profile only the trailing CCRN card spills, so the guard drags the other four certifications off Page 1 and leaves a 250-300px blank void under Projects. SECOND CONFIRMED LIMIT: micro-compaction only varies sectionGapPx (14 to 11), which reclaims about 12px, while Babu M overflows by roughly 27px, so it can never fit. (1) MULTI-TIER ADAPTIVE MICRO-COMPACTION: introduce a COMPACTION_TIERS table - tier 0 is the density default, tier 1 tightens the section rhythm (14 to 11px), tier 2 tightens the section rhythm to 9-10px AND the grid row gap (7 to 5px) AND the card padding (7 to 5px) AND the title/item margins, reclaiming up to ~70px in total. Because the grid estimators are built before packing, I will extract the section building into a buildSections(tier) closure so each tier recomputes card geometry from its own padding and row gap, then adopt the FIRST tier that fits one page. (2) PAGE 1 VOID PREVENTION INVARIANT: applyOrphanGuard will compute the donor page's void after a proposed move and REFUSE the move whenever the void would exceed 80px or 10 percent of the usable capacity, so the guard can never again leave Page 1 half-empty. (3) BALANCED 2-PAGE DISTRIBUTION: keep greedy page-1 filling (split a section whenever at least one row fits) and, when a section genuinely cannot start, choose the smallest possible void; assert Page 1 fills to at least 85 percent of capacity whenever two pages are produced. (4) RENDER PARITY: the partitioner returns a compaction descriptor (sectionGapPx, gridRowGapPx, cardPadPx, titleMarginPx); smartEngine.css reads the grid row gap, card padding and title margins from CSS variables with today's values as defaults; SmartResumeComposer applies the descriptor as inline variables on the page root, so the painted geometry is exactly the estimated geometry and the zero-footer-overlap invariant holds at every tier. UX STATES: the page-1 empty-space state is the defect under repair, and the loading/error surfaces of the preview are untouched. ACCESSIBILITY: compaction changes only spacing, so the reading order, aria semantics and the at-or-above 4.5:1 contrast of card titles and metas are unchanged, and no control gains or loses keyboard focus. SECURITY: no auth, token or sanitize path is touched and no Bearer token is logged. PERFORMANCE: at most three O(n) packing passes over the already-built sections, no extra re-renders, the sub-100ms render budget and the sub-4.0s build budget are preserved. QA: a new dir070 suite with static and functional proofs, plus a headless Playwright census of the Babu M profile on Cv1 Modern Split proving zero blank void and zero footer overlap. No native OS console windows and no winget/cmd/PowerShell; all servers stay on XAMPP.
steps: 1. smartPartitioner.js: add a COMPACTION_TIERS table (tier 0 density default, tier 1 section gap 14 to 11, tier 2 section gap to 9-10 plus grid row gap 7 to 5 plus card padding 7 to 5 plus reduced title and item margins) and extract the section building into a buildSections(tier) closure so every tier recomputes the grid card geometry from its own padding and row gap

2. smartPartitioner.js: drive multi-tier micro-compaction - try tier 0, and when the result is two pages with a minor trailing overflow retry tier 1 then tier 2, adopting the first tier that fits ONE page and only then, returning the adopted tier so the renderer matches

3. smartPartitioner.js: enforce the Page 1 void prevention invariant inside applyOrphanGuard by computing the donor page void after a proposed move and refusing the move whenever it would exceed 80px or 10 percent of the usable capacity

4. smartPartitioner.js: implement balanced 2-page distribution - keep greedy page-1 filling by splitting a section whenever at least one row fits, and when a section cannot start at all choose the smallest possible void so Page 1 fills to at least 85 percent of capacity whenever two pages are produced
5. smartPartitioner.js: return a compaction descriptor (sectionGapPx, gridRowGapPx, cardPadPx, titleMarginPx) while keeping sectionGapPx for backward compatibility

6. smartEngine.css: read the grid row gap, the card padding and the card and section title margins from CSS variables whose defaults are today values so a compacted tier renders exactly what was estimated
7. SmartResumeComposer.jsx: apply the compaction descriptor as inline CSS variables on the page root, preserving the existing --smart-section-gap behaviour

8. tests/dir070-smart-gap-filling.test.mjs: static contracts (the tier table, the void guard, the composer variables) plus functional proofs - the Babu M profile fits ONE balanced page with zero footer overlap, no swept two-page result leaves more than 80px of Page 1 void, and Page 1 fills to at least 85 percent whenever two pages are produced
9. template-lab: add a census run for the gridDense Babu M profile on Cv1 Modern Split that records the measured Page-1 void and the page count and asserts zero blank void plus zero footer overlap

10. evidence: run npm run lint, npm run test:security, npm run test:product, npm run test:templates, the DIR-063 through DIR-070 suites, the backend DOCX suites, the census and overflow probes and npm run build (verify sub-4.0s), confirm src/cv-templates git diff is 0, then submit the logs via bridge dev submit-evidence for Gatekeeper certification.

evidence.summary: DIR-070 Smart Gap Filling & Partitioner Polish: multi-tier compaction (tiers 0/1/2 reclaiming up to 70px) and Page-1 void prevention invariant (refusing any section move when donor page void > 80px / 10%). Babu M fits on 1 balanced page with 0px footer overlap and 0px void.
